name: Great Commission
overview: The Great Commission, as revealed in the final chapters of Matthew and Mark, emphasizes Jesus' authority and the mandate given to His disciples to spread the gospel worldwide. After His resurrection, Jesus instructed His followers to make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, and teaching them to obey His commands. This mission is empowered by Christ's promise to be with His people always, ensuring His presence as they proclaim the gospel to every creature.
